title: ID0409106-DC/Si-D/NO-[bucVuF] Income_Phaseloss
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Outlets out of order due to Income_PhaseLoss error flag
Solution:
Replace AC input from converter
One converter also E4 active. Disconnect the converter from AC Input. Charger worked fine. Tried to connect the AC input from the not working converter, to the next converter. Then this converter also reports E4. AC input defective.

Problem Description
: Outlets out of order due to Income_Phaseloss error flag
Troubleshooting
: As we already aligned and tested on site, it seems that the problem comes from the AC input of converter =
2102313PAVKXPA001397SA002200080208FW:DC903PF903H100. It has Error4 which means AC Open Phase which is causing the Phase loss.
We tried already swapping converters and we have the same issue with the working ones.
After removing this converter from the grid, the charger is operational again.
Please proceed to replace the AC income of this specific converter and try again.
For future reference, your case number is
0409106
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
